checks.text: Adding a habit by name shows it in the list; empty or duplicate names are refused with an inline message.
Ticking today's box for a habit marks it done and the streak shows 1.
With fixture history of 3 consecutive done days ending yesterday, ticking today shows streak 4 (seed the mock store in the test).
Missing a day resets the streak to 0 the next day (use Playwright's clock to move the date).
Each habit shows a 7-day row; done days and missed days differ by more than color (icon or label), so the axe scan and a screen reader can tell them apart.
Renaming and deleting a habit work; delete asks for confirmation in a dialog that Escape closes.
